Attach NDVI statistics to an AOI

attach_ndvi.Rd

Extracts NDVI values from GeoTIFF chips covering an AOI, computes area-weighted summary statistics (mean, sd, min, max, median), and joins them back to the input data. All statistics are weighted by covered surface area in square meters, ensuring comparability across latitudes and AOI sizes.

Usage

attach_ndvi(
  df,
  out_dir = NULL,
  deduplicate = TRUE,
  crs_planar = 3857,
  prefix = "ndvi_",
  progress = TRUE
)

Arguments

df

A data object carrying the AOI (produced by mutate_aoi_*()). Must contain an AOI identifier column and have an attached AOI geometry.

out_dir

Directory where NDVI GeoTIFF files are located. Used if no recorded tiles are found in attr(df, "ndvi_aoi").

deduplicate

Logical. If TRUE (default), AOIs with identical geometry are extracted only once, then mapped back.

crs_planar

EPSG code of the projected CRS used to compute surface areas in meters. Defaults to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857).

prefix

Prefix for output column names. Default is "ndvi_".

progress

Logical. If TRUE (default), show progress messages during extraction.

Value

The input df, augmented with NDVI summary columns.

Details

  • AOI handling: The AOI is validated and transformed to crs_planar to ensure that surface area is measured in square meters.

  • Summaries: Each NDVI value is weighted by its overlap area (m²) when computing the statistics.

  • Output: Five new columns are created per AOI: ndvi_mean, ndvi_sd, ndvi_min, ndvi_max, ndvi_median.

Attributes

Attributes of df are preserved. AOI and fetch metadata (e.g., attr(df, "traktr_aoi"), attr(df, "ndvi_aoi")) remain available.

See also

attach_landuse, mutate_aoi_h3, mutate_aoi_buffer, fetch_ndvi

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
df <- mutate_aoi_h3(my_points, res = 10)
df <- fetch_ndvi(df, out_dir = "data/ndvi", from = Sys.Date()-30, to = Sys.Date())
df <- attach_ndvi(df, out_dir = "data/ndvi", crs_planar = 3857)

# Inspect statistics
head(df[, c("h3", "ndvi_mean", "ndvi_sd")])
} # }
